notes:
Show the inside of a chip on double click; lexicon pages for own chips

A chip on the board was a black box: a double click now opens its
circuit to look at and try out (fixed, switches still flip, the arrow
goes back). The lexicon gets a page per own chip with its pinout and a
pin table with the descriptions. Clock inputs are now also found
through nested chips (REG4 is built from REG1). Plans for audio
circuits and 500+ levels with player levels go to docs/geplant.md.
